name: ai-digital-agriculture-manager
description: AI数字农业管家系统 MVP

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test:patrol-demo: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && node scripts/stage2-test.mjs
